{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000BPPH7B6Y2QW6A","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
node A "Device A" ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client/src/edge-client.ts"
node B "Device B" right-of A ref="packages/core/mesh/edge-client/src/edge-client.ts"
group cloud "EDGE" max-width=3 {
  node Router "Router" ref="https://github.com/dxos/edge/tree/main/packages/services/router/src/worker/router/router.ts"
  node Db "DB service" ref="https://github.com/dxos/edge/tree/main/packages/services/db-service/src/worker/automerge/automerge-replicator.ts"
  node Identity "Identity service" ref="https://github.com/dxos/edge/tree/main/packages/services/identity-service/src/agent/agent.ts"
  node Compute "Compute service" ref="https://github.com/dxos/edge/tree/main/packages/services/compute-service/src/runtime/workers-for-platforms-runtime.ts"
  node Ai "AI service" ref="https://github.com/dxos/edge/tree/main/packages/services/ai-service/src/entrypoint/ai-service.ts"
}
edge A -> B "direct link"
edge A:bottom -> Router:left "WebSocket"
edge B:bottom -> Router:right "WebSocket"
edge Router -> Identity, Db, Compute bus
edge Db -> Compute "triggers"
edge Compute -> Ai "prompts"
